item.title: Rust-Written Lua Compiler Runs Scripts Natively on Bare-Metal Arduino
item.description: TinyLua: a zero-VM Lua native compiler written in Rust. Compiles Lua source directly to AVR/ARM machine code for Arduino bare-metal — no interpreter, no GC, no runtime. Scripting language performance at C level.
